# Jeremy McKeehen

> From code to plastic.

Sole engineer at MetaTravelers for five years, building the commerce, order routing, and attribution systems behind a physical product business shipping into 22 countries. Two years full-stack at Allvue on a fintech platform, after a year in frontline production support for private-equity clients. Publishes open source developer tooling and contributes to Redis, Gazebo, ROS, and OpenClaw.

Site: https://www.trippyogi.com
Email: peace@trippyogi.com
MCP: https://www.trippyogi.com/mcp

## Experience

### Co-founder and Technical Founder — MetaTravelers
2021 – present
Built the commerce, fulfillment, launch, infrastructure, and agent systems behind a physical product business shipping internationally.
- Built the systems behind 10,000+ physical units shipped to 22 countries: order routing and transformation feeding the 3PL, Shopify fulfillment automation configured on top of it, and GraphQL Admin API integrations for support order lookup and paid-attribution reconciliation.
- Architected and shipped a digital launch system spanning smart contracts, frontend, 3D generation, automated rendering, cloud infrastructure, and delivery. Sold 7,777 units to 2,689 unique buyers over a three-day mint; the final public tranche of 2,935 cleared in 15 minutes at ~195 per minute.
- Owned production infrastructure across AWS EC2/S3/Lambda/IAM, Cloudflare, and CI/CD, plus storefronts, internal tools, data pipelines, deployments, and post-launch issue resolution.
- Ran the company on agent workflows across support, reporting, content, and fulfillment, with human review at the checkpoints that need judgment. Built Baton to rank which of those reviews to do first.

### Software Engineer, Full Stack — Allvue Systems
2017-03 – 2020-02
Two years of full-stack engineering on the Everest and K2 fund-accounting platforms after a year in frontline production support for private-equity clients.
- Delivered front-office and back-office features, data migrations, and internal automation across C#/.NET Framework, TypeScript/JavaScript, Knockout.js, Python, MongoDB, and SQL.
- Designed a Cucumber regression suite for loan-reconciliation workflows that let business analysts author natural-language tests, removing ~800 manual QA hours per cycle.
- Onboarded three institutional clients off legacy back-office systems, writing Python pipelines that extracted, transformed, validated, and loaded decades of reporting.
- Owned frontline production support for private-equity and fund-accounting clients, converting recurring tickets into reproducible bug reports and permanent fixes with engineering.
